description: External alterations to the seven storey building incorporating the demolition of the rear extension, installation of replacement curtain wall glazing, replacement of non-combustible cladding, installation of louvered ventilation panels and alterations to the doors.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [HH_LP100, XC114-SBA-H-XX-DR- A-15001 (P1), XC114-SBA-H-XX-DR- A-15004 (P1), XC114-SBA-H-XX-DR- A-05001 (P1), XC114-SBA-H-XX-DR- A-05002 (P1), XC114-SBA-H-XX-DR- A-05003 (P1), 
XC114-SBA-H-XX-DR- A-05004 (P1), Facade Performance specification ( Doc ref: 0055074 (P02), dt: 31/03/2023), Fire Safety Strategy (Prepared by Ashton Fire, Issue 01, dt: 06/03/2023)- Received 04/05/2023; XC114-SBA-H-GF-DR- A-04101 (P1), Design and access Statement (Prepared by Scapolan Burney, Rev: A, dt: 07/07/2023)- Received 07/07/2023; XC114-SBA-H-XX-DR- A-15002 (P2), XC114-SBA-H-XX-DR- A-15003 (P2)- Received 11/07/2023].

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
